timeline.title: Introduced ReviewerAgent
timeline.commitMessage: feat(agents): add ReviewerAgent for independent evaluation loop
timeline.reason: Research outputs needed an independent evaluation loop to reduce hallucination before output serialization.
timeline.detail: ReviewerAgent acts as a distinct node in the LangGraph execution flow. It inspects ResearchState and proposes revision cycles if evaluation thresholds are not met.

timeline.title: Optimized Graph Retrieval
timeline.commitMessage: perf(retrieval): cache semantic relationship paths in MemoryStore
timeline.reason: Graph traversal latency was bottlenecking sub-second retrieval across deep memory chains.
timeline.detail: Implemented memoized relationship path traversal and reduced multi-hop traversal time by 64%.

timeline.title: Migrated Vector Store to Qdrant
timeline.commitMessage: refactor(store): replace ChromaDB backend with Qdrant cluster
timeline.reason: ChromaDB struggled with complex metadata filtering under concurrent multi-agent query load.
timeline.detail: Replaced ChromaDB implementation with QdrantVectorStore supporting payload filtering and payload indexing.

timeline.title: Initial LangGraph Architecture
timeline.reason: Foundation release establishing multi-agent research workflow.
timeline.detail: Created foundational ResearchAgent, LiteratureAgent, and HypothesisAgent graphs utilizing ChromaDB vector retrieval.
